title: Object Storage: outage exclusions
content:
Object Storage outage exclusions is defined as follows: Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

| Contract tier | Outage exclusions |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the outage exclusions entry is customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer.
